title: SettlementFeedback
description: An ERC-8004 feedback file that carries a settlement claim. A reader verifies `settlement` against public escrow events: the deal settled, the rater (`clientAddress`) was its buyer or seller, and the rated agent's bound address was the other party. Any escrow whose settlement events are indexed can be named here; the fields outside `settlement` follow the ERC-8004 feedback file.

agentRegistry.description: CAIP-10 of the ERC-8004 Identity Registry the agentId belongs to.

clientAddress.description: The rater. Must equal the on-chain clientAddress of the feedback entry.

settlement.description: The settled deal this rating rests on.

contract.description: The escrow contract that emitted the settlement.
